verdict.rationale: The quickstart documents installable SDKs with full write/query code samples for Python (pip), TypeScript (npm @turbopuffer/turbopuffer), Go (turbopuffer-go/v2) and Java (com.turbopuffer.client), plus Ruby and Rust. The API docs refer to these as official client libraries that handle compression and async operations transparently. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and an explicit Java install/package coordinate (only the import is shown).
